categories.main_business_segments: WuXi Unicomp Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and service of industrial X-ray intelligent inspection equipment and core components. Its products and technologies are mainly applied in integrated circuits and electronic manufacturing, new energy batteries, castings, weldments, and materials inspection fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on X-ray full-industry chain technology research, including X-ray source design and manufacturing, intelligent X-ray inspection equipment, and X-ray imaging software. Key technologies include micro-focus X-ray sources, high-voltage generators, AI-based defect recognition algorithms, 3D/CT tomography, and digital radiography. Production methods involve standardized and customized manufacturing of X-ray equipment and modular assembly of core components such as X-ray sources.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in integrated circuits and electronic manufacturing, new energy battery production, and automotive casting and materials sectors. Notable clients include Infineon, Amphenol, Luxshare Precision, BYD Semiconductor, CATL, and BYD Lithium Battery. The company also serves emerging markets like food foreign object detection and scientific research.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in East China, South China, North China, Central China, and Southwest China regions. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production bases in Singapore, Malaysia, Hungary, and the United States, with overseas sales accounting for 8% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: WuXi Unicomp operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the industrial X-ray inspection supply chain, manufacturing core components like X-ray sources and high-voltage generators, as well as complete intelligent inspection equipment. It also provides software solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive supplier in the X-ray inspection industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on developing series of industrial-grade X-ray sources, AI intelligent detection algorithms, and 3D/CT imaging technologies. It aims to achieve import substitution for core components, expand applications across multiple industries, and enhance global market penetration. R&D efforts include breakthroughs in micro-focus and high-power small-focus X-ray sources, AI model upgrades, and expansion into complementary detection technologies like optical, ultrasonic, and magnetic particle inspection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of industrial X-ray intelligent inspection equipment and core components such as X-ray sources. The company also earns income from after-sales services, spare parts, and software solutions tailored to customer-specific inspection needs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: WuXi Unicomp is a domestic leader in industrial X-ray intelligent inspection equipment, especially in integrated circuits and new energy battery sectors. It competes with international firms like Hamamatsu and Thermo Fisher in core X-ray source technology. The company has successfully broken foreign monopolies in micro-focus X-ray sources and maintains a leading position in AI-based industrial X-ray detection in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 739.5 million, a 25.89% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 143.3 million, up 25.44%. R&D investment accounted for 11.02% of revenue. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 3.64 billion and a net asset value of RMB 3.23 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: WuXi Unicomp offers advanced, domestically developed industrial X-ray inspection solutions with high precision, efficiency, and intelligent defect recognition powered by AI. Its products address critical 'bottleneck' issues in precision inspection for integrated circuits and new energy batteries, ensuring supply chain autonomy and reducing reliance on imports. The company’s comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and global presence provide customers with innovative, reliable, and customized inspection solutions.
